archive_eth_getCode_historical.detail: eth_getCode(0x0, 0x34ad51) served successfully -> zero's RPC answers historical code. Note the block: the funding tx is in 0x34ad52 and the probe is one block EARLIER, because getCode(N) returns end-of-block-N state — after the tx and after anything else in N (METHOD §4). abstract also served historical code for all 354 of its contract recipients (see abstract_full_sweep). Probe the remaining 5 chains in Phase 0.

eth_getCode_at_concrete_tip.detail: All 7 live endpoints served eth_getCode(0x...8006, <eth_blockNumber result>). This is why resolve_l2_code.py turns --block latest into a concrete block number before writing anything: it costs nothing and makes the one-block-per-cache rule enforceable (METHOD §2).

eth_call_identity_probes.detail: name()/owner()/implementation() returned '0x' on the abstract proxy family and errored on the era sample. Do not use as primary evidence (METHOD §6 pitfall 5).

abstract_clone_family.membership_note: These are ranks 1, 5 and 6 of abstract's recipients — NOT the top three. abstract_full_sweep.note: 352 of abstract's 354 contract recipients share the fbd752b5... bytecode — the sampled three were the tip of it, and the family, not the head of the tx distribution, is the unit of attribution (METHOD §5).
